sections.text:
Ability Power 180. Damages all enemies with physical light damage.
Added effect: Increases all stats of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds and casts “Justice’s Advocate” (casts a ward when used and casts a 10% constant heal effect) on yourself for 40 seconds.
Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
